title: Seaside apartments on the islands of Pag and Cres
metaDesc: Three family-run apartments a few steps from the sea in Croatia: Apartment Rino in Košljun on the island of Pag, and Punta Blue and Punta Orange in Pogana Bay on the island of Cres.
heroTitle: A few steps from the sea
heroSub: Three cosy apartments on the islands of Pag and Cres, hosted by one family.
intro:
Apartment Rino lies in Košljun on the island of Pag, 30 m from the sea and surrounded by ancient pine forests. Apartments Punta Blue and Punta Orange share a house in Pogana Bay on the island of Cres, only 5 m from the sea.

All three are quiet and relaxing places to spend your holidays, with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a terrace and everything you need for a comfortable stay.
host:
I’m fortunate to welcome people from all over the world. If you need any information, please send me an inquiry and I will always find a way to make your stay comfortable.

I hope you will enjoy your stay and wish you an amazing holiday!
